confidence.overallReason: Commit 39e1fe0 closes the originally demonstrated upload, unknown-length, request-size, one-shot call, Firebase timeout, EXIF 5/7, multipart evidence, and real-restart gaps under fresh tests. It does not close the broader required ownership contract: public compressCamera(File) still deletes any supplied file in finally without proving ownership, startup sweep classifies every file in the transient directory as owned without the prefix/capability checks used elsewhere, and ManagedPhoto's module-visible constructor accepts both the file and claimed cache directory so the ownership capability is forgeable by any app-module caller.

task: T5 Android auth/API client and ephemeral photo lifecycle hardening re-verification

priorIndependentReview.preservation: All seven prior findings are evaluated individually below; this report replaces but does not erase the prior needs-fix history.

blockingFindings.title: Camera compression still deletes arbitrary foreign files
blockingFindings.requirement: Arbitrary foreign files are never deleted; only lifecycle-owned transient cache artifacts may be deleted in finally.
evidence: android/app/src/main/java/com/junited31/leftovers/photo/PhotoLifecycle.kt:59 exposes compressCamera(file: File) rather than an owned capability.
PhotoLifecycle.kt:59-63 calls file.delete() unconditionally in finally after success or every failure, with no canonical-directory, prefix, or ManagedPhoto ownership check.

The hardening regression foreign_file_cannot_become_managed_or_be_deleted calls only manage(foreign); it never passes a foreign File through compressCamera, so the passing test does not cover this deletion path.
A valid persistent JPEG outside cacheDir/leftovers-photos will be decoded into an owned output and then the original will be deleted; malformed/oversize foreign inputs are also deleted in finally.
blockingFindings.impact: A caller can lose a persistent or caller-owned camera source simply by using the public camera compression entry point. This is the same root ownership class as the original upload deletion finding, on a sibling path.
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Accept an ownership-proving camera artifact/capability, or canonical-check the input against the exact lifecycle directory and prefix before deleting. Add success and failure regressions proving a foreign valid/malformed file survives.

blockingFindings.title: Startup sweep deletes prefix-free files inside the transient directory
blockingFindings.requirement: Startup sweep removes only owned files older than 24 hours while preserving old foreign files.
evidence: PhotoLifecycle.kt:98-100 sweeps every element returned by ownedCacheFiles.
PhotoLifecycle.kt:103 defines ownedCacheFiles as every regular file under cacheDir/leftovers-photos; unlike manage/delete at lines 28-50 it applies no leftovers-photo- prefix check.

Both committed and independent restart probes place the old foreign file outside leftovers-photos, so they do not adversarially test an old prefix-free file inside the directory that sweep claims as owned.
blockingFindings.impact: Any other app feature or migration that places a file in the dedicated directory can have it deleted after 24 hours even though it cannot be managed by the ownership API.
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Use one canonical ownership predicate for manage, delete, and sweep, and add an old prefix-free in-directory preservation regression.

blockingFindings.title: ManagedPhoto ownership capability is forgeable within the app module
blockingFindings.requirement: Do not rely on caller-supplied directory/prefix claims or a prefix-only ownership token.
evidence: PhotoLifecycle.kt:24-26 declares ManagedPhoto's constructor internal and accepts both file and cacheDirectory from the caller.

Any source in the Android app module can construct ManagedPhoto(foreignPrefixNamedFile, foreignPrefixNamedFile.parentFile); delete then sees canonical parent equality and a leftovers-photo- prefix and deletes the foreign file.
LeftoversApi accepts ManagedPhoto directly, so the new type is not an unforgeable lifecycle-issued capability inside the production module.
blockingFindings.impact: The ownership guarantee depends on every future internal caller voluntarily using PhotoLifecycle factories, recreating the original misuse risk for prefix-named persistent files.
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Make lifecycle issuance unforgeable: hide construction behind a factory tied to the private canonical lifecycle directory and do not accept a caller-provided ownership directory.

priorFindingResults.finding: Arbitrary upload File deleted in finally
priorFindingResults.evidence: LeftoversApi now accepts ManagedPhoto, its delete re-canonicalizes and checks exact parent plus prefix, and foreign manage regression passes. Public compressCamera(File) remains an unchecked sibling deletion path and ManagedPhoto remains forgeable module-wide.

priorFindingResults.finding: Unknown-length content URI bypasses 64 MiB cap
priorFindingResults.evidence: Negative/unknown length is copied through an 8 KiB counting loop, throws immediately after MAX_SOURCE_BYTES is exceeded, removes the bounded copy in finally, and fresh unknown-length 64 MiB+1 regression passed with no owned residue. No API request can be constructed because compression does not return a ManagedPhoto.

AtomicBoolean started.compareAndSet admits one execute; the loser returns AlreadyExecuted. Fresh two-thread regression observed one success, one AlreadyExecuted, and MockWebServer requestCount=1. call is assigned once and cancel targets that sole call.

UTF-8 byte length greater than 256 KiB returns PayloadTooLarge before token acquisition/request construction for both JSON and multipart context. Fresh regression observed tokenCalls=0 and requestCount=0.

BoundedTaskWaiter defaults to 15 seconds and maps TimeoutException, execution failure, task cancellation, and interruption to TokenUnavailableException while restoring interrupt state. LeftoversApi catches only the typed token error. Fresh never-completing task regression terminated under one second with typed failure.

priorFindingResults.finding: Multipart evidence hashes envelope and restart is simulated
priorFindingResults.evidence: Connected test parses the photo part by multipart boundary, byte-compares it with the compressed JPEG, records separate envelope/JPEG sizes, and hashes only the JPEG. An independent force-stop/cold-launch probe changed PID 22289 to 22472, removed stale owned, and preserved fresh owned plus old foreign files.
Orientation 5 and 7 now apply distinct mirrored rotations. Fresh JVM and SM_F711N tests used asymmetric red/blue JPEGs, asserted 640x1280 dimensions, opposite vertical color polarity, and passed.
